steps.title: Lower the seventh once more
steps.body:
**diminished 7th chord** means a diminished triad with its seventh one half step below the minor seventh. Bdim7 has B, D, F and Ab: four sounds spaced by three half steps when arranged upward from B. It is written dim7 or °7.

**Why it matters:** Bdim7 and Bm7b5 differ by one sound, so they must not be treated as the same chord.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: From Bm7b5 lower string 3 fret 2 to fret 1: A becomes Ab. The four played strings 5 through 2 now sound B, F, Ab and D. Use a separate comfortable finger for each position.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Compare A and Ab slowly, then compare the two chord sounds. The guitar app may label Ab as G#: these are the same sound.
